description: This file defines the IStorageManager interface in the WPEFramework project, providing methods for storage management such as create, get, delete, and clear storage for applications.

classes.name: IStorageManager
classes.description: Interface for managing storage related operations for applications within the WPEFramework.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates storage for a specified application, returning the storage path or an error reason.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves storage location and usage details for a specified application.

methods.name: DeleteStorage
methods.description: Deletes storage associated with a specified application.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears storage for a specified application, including device storage.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears all application data except for exempted app IDs.

calls: Core::hresult CreateStorage(const string&, const uint32_t&, string&, string&)
Core::hresult GetStorage(const string&, const int32_t&, const int32_t&, string&, uint32_t&, uint32_t&)
